text:
Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists equipment inspection 
checklist I2, which must be performed every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Mahmoud Mohamed Tawfeq 
at Estad 220kv substation, tested at 21 Jan 2004, accepted by 
general director eng. Mostafa Mohamed Hamed Shaker, and 
approved by eng. Samir Saleh Ismaiel; Head Sector of extra high voltage Cairo 
zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
Circuit breaker must be isolated & proper earthing at the two sides of CB area is required
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage)
Change remote/local switch m to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet & safety shoes
Portable air blower, SF6 gas detector, buzzer,
Screw driver, and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
Check internal tightness of hydraulic components.
Check there 
 is no condensation in the cabinets, ensure that the heater is working.
Check the condition of the electrical connections
Check the 
 tightness of earthing conductors.
Verification
Measure thresholds of SF6 pressure regulators 
 3.2 alarm, 3.0 block and alarm
Measure operating time of the circuit breaker.
Measure resistance contact.
Measure thresholds of hydraulic drive.
 336 bar 
 Stop the pump
 316 bar SP1 Start 
 the pump working
 270 bar SP2 Block (ON)
 250 bar SP3 Block (ON - 
 OFF)
 Arrive to zero.
 180 bar Nitrogen pressure manually (from 5-6 
 times)
 3 minute the time required for pump to rise from 180bar to 336bar and stop 
 automatically
